_instructions: This is the clean local JSON data store. DockFlow writes user-created accounts, suppliers, imports, deliveries, scans, and history here.
On the first API start, DockFlow creates one administrator from BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME, BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD, and BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL.
Create supplier and staff accounts in Administration, then import an SDS workbook to begin a fresh trial.
Do not store SMTP passwords, tokens, or other secrets in this file. Keep secrets in .env only.
